issue.title: Vault-format guide still lists the retired REFERENCES walk tier
issue.description: At f00854be, docs/reference/vault-format.md:171-172 lists PRE → NEW → PROJECTS → PENDING → NEXT → TICKLER → REFERENCES → ROTTEN → POST (plus RECURRING when due). src/native/freshness/state.rs Tier and docs/freshness.md use PRE → NEW → PROJECTS → PENDING → NEXT → RECURRING → TICKLER → ROTTEN → POST. The page predates bob-cli-d7 and was not edited by this epic. Correct the sentence and check nearby explanations against the current contract; run just docs-check. Scope is a focused prose correction, with no behavior or memory changes. No semantic duplicate found across task statuses or recent tasks; no causally related active epic. Proposing bead: bob-cli-d7.4, notes 1 and 2 (one distinct proposal).

task_type_fields.impact: The public vault guide teaches an obsolete review order.
task_type_fields.repro: Read the morning-walk order in vault-format.md and compare with src/native/freshness/state.rs Tier and docs/freshness.md; REFERENCES is retired and RECURRING belongs before TICKLER.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-d7.4 notes 1 and 2 proposed this documentation correction. Landing independently confirmed the guide contradicts the current evaluator and freshness contract.
